svg.title: keepSignedIn
svg.desc: Open tabs look attended: some sites also sign you out from inside an open page that gets no keystroke, mouse move or scroll for a while. Air Canada does it after 15 minutes, "stay signed in" or not. An agent's tab never gets that kind of input, so a tab left on such a site would sign you out everywhere. While the daemon runs, any of its tabs on a keepSignedIn site gets a Shift key tap every 15 seconds, which the page counts as input and which changes nothing on it. Tabs a command is using, and handoff windows, are left alone.
